headword: {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A train that skips some stations to provide faster service than a local train, but stops at more stations than a limited express.

examples.japanese: {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}える→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧。
examples.english: To transfer to an express train.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{止|と}まりません→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Express trains do not stop at this station.

examples.japanese: {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本数|ほんすう}→本数：13154_honsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}らされた→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{通勤客|つうきんきゃく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Because the number of express trains was reduced, commuters are voicing their dissatisfaction.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧ (express) and ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧ (train). In the Japanese train classification system, ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧ sits between ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧/⟦{各停|かくてい}→各停：09214_kakutei⟧ (local) and ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ (limited express) in terms of speed and number of stops. Many JR ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧ services have been discontinued or upgraded to ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧, but the term remains common on private railways.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride an express train
- {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{停車駅|ていしゃえき}: stations where the express stops
- {急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通過|つうか}する→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧: the express passes through
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: express surcharge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特急列車|とっきゅうれっしゃ}→特急列車：25987_tokkyuuressha⟧: limited express train — faster, with fewer stops and usually a surcharge
- ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧: rapid train — a category between local and express on some lines; no surcharge
- ⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧: local train — stops at every station
